# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
ssbcpts <- cpt.mean(data = SSB_full$SSB, method = "BinSeg", Q = 6)
plot(ssbcpts, type = "l", cpt.col = "navyblue", xlab = "Index", pt.widt = 4)
cpts(ssbcpts)
#### Index: 4,    18,   20,   40,   54,   72
#### years: 1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018

### bcp analysis
bcp.ssb <- bcp(SSB_full$SSB)
plot(bcp.ssb, main = "SSB")
which(bcp.ssb$posterior.prob >= 0.5)
#### Index: 20,   37,   54
#### years: 1966, 1983, 2000

#### Changepoints detected by both methods +-1 year and min. 5 years between points:
#### 1966, 2000
#### Opinion: would include 1986/1983 (looks significant) as only detected by BinSeg
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Load plotting function from "functions.R"
source("R/functions.R")

### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = SSB_full, 
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("steelblue", "orange", "grey", "purple"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 15,
       height = 10,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
#SSB_test <- SSB_full[-75,]?
ccf(SSB_full$SSB[-(78:79)], ICES_data$F, type = "correlation") # 3 years lag

#### Make time-lag object
SSB_F_lag <- tibble(
  year = SSB_full$year[-(77:79)],
  SSB = SSB_full$SSB[-(1:3)],
  F = ICES_data$F[-(78:77)])


### Break-point analysis
bpts <- strucchange::breakpoints(SSB_F_lag$SSB/1000000 ~ SSB_F_lag$F)
plot(bpts)
summary(bpts)

bpts_sum <- summary(bpts)
opt_brks <- opt_bpts(bpts_sum$RSS["BIC",])
opt_brks #### 4
bpts2 <- strucchange:: breakpoints(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
best_brk <- SSB_F_lag$F[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk
####  0.32 0.34 0.32

par(mfrow = c(1,1))
ci_mod <- confint(bpts, breaks = opt_brks)
plot(SSB_F_lag$SSB/1000000 ~ SSB_F_lag$F, type = "p")
for (i in 1: opt_brks) {
  abline(v = SSB_F_lag$F[ci_mod$confint[i,2]], col = "blue")
  abline(v = SSB_F_lag$F[ci_mod$confint[i,1]], col = "red", lty = 3)
  abline(v = SSB_F_lag$F[ci_mod$confint[i,3]], col = "red", lty = 3)
}
### Get corresponding years:
best_brk_years <- SSB_F_lag$year[bpts2$breakpoints]
best_brk_years
#### 1962, 1977, 1991
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(SSB_F_lag, best_brk_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

```{r}
hyst_phases <- NULL
hyst_phases[SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[1]] <- "steelblue"
hyst_phases[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[1] & SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[2]] <- "darkorange"
hyst_phases[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[2] & SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[3]] <- "purple"
hyst_phases[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[3] & SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[4]] <- "lightgreen"
hyst_phases[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[4]] <- "indianred"

SSB_F_lag_breakpoint_hyst <- ggplot(data = SSB_F_lag, aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000))+
  geom_path(colour = "grey80")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 564.599, linetype="dashed",color="gray30")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.21, linetype="dashed",color="gray30")+
  geom_label(x = 0.21, y = 1150, label = expression("F"[MSY]), color="gray30", size = 3.5)+
  geom_label(x = 0.55, y = 564.599, label = expression("MSY B"[trigger]), color="gray30", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold")+
  #geom_text_repel(aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000, label = year), colour = hyst_phases)+
  geom_point(colour = hyst_phases)+
  geom_smooth(data = SSB_F_lag[SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[1], ], aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000),
              method = "lm", colour = "steelblue")+
  geom_smooth(data = SSB_F_lag[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[1] & SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[2], ],
              aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000), method = "lm", colour = "darkorange")+
  geom_smooth(data = SSB_F_lag[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[2] & SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[3], ],
              aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000), method = "lm", colour = "purple")+
  geom_smooth(data = SSB_F_lag[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[3] & SSB_F_lag$year <= best_brk_years[4], ],
              aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000), method = "lm", colour = "lightgreen")+
  geom_smooth(data = SSB_F_lag[SSB_F_lag$year > best_brk_years[4], ], aes(x = F, y = SSB/1000),
              method = "lm", colour = "indianred")+
  labs(x = "", y = "")+
  geom_text_repel(data = SSB_F_lag, aes(label = year), #1960
                  point.padding = 0.2,nudge_y = 100, nudge_x = -0.05, size=3,col="gray30", segment.size =0.2 )+
  geom_text_repel(data = SSB_F_lag[37, ], aes(label = year), #1991
                  point.padding = 0.2, nudge_y = 0, nudge_x = 0.2, size=3,col="gray30", segment.size =0.2 )+
  geom_text_repel(data = SSB_F_lag[53, ], aes(label = year), #2007
                  point.padding = 0.2, nudge_y = 0,nudge_x= -0.2, size=3,col="gray30", segment.size =0.2 )+
  geom_text_repel(data = SSB_F_lag[64, ], aes(label = year), #2021
                  point.padding = 0.2, nudge_x = -0.1, size=3, col="gray30", segment.size =0.2 )+
  xlim(0, 0.8)+
  theme_test()+
  theme(plot.tag.position = c(0.9, 0.9),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12))
SSB_F_lag_breakpoint_hyst
```
